fix_command:
systemctl --failed --type=service --no-legend --plain |
  awk '$2 == "loaded" {print $1}' |
  while read -r u; do
    [ "$(systemctl show -p Type --value "$u")" = oneshot ] || echo "$u"
  done |
  xargs -r systemctl restart
